units.source_text: 良平带着这两个比自己还小两岁的孩子，想要再推一次矿车。

en.t: Ryohei took the two children, who were two years younger than him, and wanted to push the mine cart once more.

units.source_text: 车轮还没开始转动，突然背后传来了脚步声声。

en.t: Before the wheels had even begun to turn, the sound of footsteps suddenly came from behind.

units.source_text: 不仅如此，才刚听到脚步声，这声音立刻就变成了愤怒的叫骂声。

en.t: Not only that: no sooner had he heard the footsteps than the sound immediately turned into angry shouting.
